name: Leaf salad
summary: Forest and garden leaves rolled into a funnel with pork, shrimp, and pork skin. VietnamNet, the Vietnam News Agency, and Voice of Vietnam put the platters on Trần Cao Vân. The leaf count and the platter price are not one figure.
origin: Publishers describe gỏi lá as a Kon Tum specialty of many leaves, rolled into a funnel with pork and shrimp.
taste: The Vietnam National Authority of Tourism says one bite runs hot, sour, salty, sweet, astringent, and nutty. VietnamNet’s 14 July 2023 article separates sour mango leaf, nutty sung leaf, and astringent guava leaf. Voice of Vietnam says the leaves run sour, hot, sweet, and bitter together.
howToEat: Roll a large leaf into a funnel, add a few more leaves, then pork, shrimp, and pork skin, plus sauce, salt, and pepper. Eat it in one bite. VietnamNet on 23 July 2023 says use a large perilla or sung leaf, then 5–7 more leaves. Voice of Vietnam starts the funnel with mustard green or lettuce. The tourism authority’s article uses a sung leaf. VietnamNet on 14 July 2023 starts with mustard green or perilla.

Leaf counts, all printed, none averaged. The tourism authority’s Kon Tum food article says up to 40 kinds. VietnamNet on 14 July 2023 says 40–50. VietnamNet on 23 July 2023 says about 30, and quotes a Trần Cao Vân kitchen: 50–60 in the rainy season and about 30 in the dry season. Voice of Vietnam, on 22 May 2025, says at least 30 and up to 70, and says the dry season is the fullest platter while the rainy season is about 30. Go Vietnam’s Măng Đen article says 30–40. The two season claims disagree. Both stay.

Fillings also disagree. The tourism authority names thin boiled pork belly, river shrimp, carp, and pork skin rubbed with roasted rice powder, with fermented glutinous rice, dried shrimp, and mẹ in the sauce. VietnamNet on 14 July 2023 names boiled pork belly, carp, boiled shrimp, pork skin, peppercorns, coarse salt, and a sauce of glutinous rice, dried shrimp, pork belly, mẹ, and satay. VietnamNet on 23 July 2023 names boiled pork belly, dry-fried river shrimp, pork skin with roasted rice powder, coarse salt, black peppercorns, and green chili. The Vietnam News Agency names boiled pork belly, boiled fresh shrimp, and pork skin with roasted rice powder, and a sauce that smells of wine lees. Go Vietnam’s Măng Đen article adds rice paper to the funnel. Voice of Vietnam does not.

Platter prices, not averaged. VietnamNet on 23 July 2023 prints 100,000–150,000 VND for a platter for about 3–4 people. The Vietnam News Agency prints about 300,000–400,000 VND for a platter for 6–8 people. Go Vietnam’s Măng Đen article prints 350,000–600,000 VND for a platter for 4–6 people. A single-person price was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Trần Cao Vân, Kon Tum city. VietnamNet on 23 July 2023 says the salad is especially easy to find on that street. The Vietnam News Agency calls it phố gỏi lá. Voice of Vietnam also places a known kitchen on that street. A stall clock was not printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Goi la in Kon Tum — leaf salad on Tran Cao Van
seoDescription: A funnel of forest and garden leaves with pork, shrimp, and pork skin on Trần Cao Vân. Leaf counts and platter prices disagree, and every figure stays. A single-person price is Check on arrival.
